message.content:
**Mobile App Audit — 390px**

1. **Pure English only?** PASS — all copy is English.

2. **Position/status block as visual protagonist?** FAIL — no queue position exists; the large "This booking was cancelled" card is dominant, but there is no position/status tracker at all (mismatch with "live queue tracker" purpose).

3. **Layout defects (clipped/overlap)?**
   - PASS — no clipping or overlap; header, cards, and footer timestamp/Refresh button are cleanly separated.

**Extra defects:**
- FAIL — header title "Your turn" contradicts the cancelled state (wrong status copy).
- FAIL — large empty dead space below Refresh button (~450px).
